hint: Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states. Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-27: exploitation confirmed.
